sn56.38:1.1: bhikkhave candimasuriyā loke nupajjanti neva tāva mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti mahato obhāsassa ||
sn56.38:1.3: neva tāva rattidivā paññāyanti na māsaddhamāsā paññāyanti na utusaṃvaccharā paññāyanti || || 3.
sn56.38:2.1: Yato ca kho bhikkhave candimasuriyā loke uppajjanti || atha mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti mahato obhāsassa ||
sn56.38:2.2: na andhantamam tadā hoti na andhakāratimisā ||
sn56.38:2.3: atha rattidivā paññāyanti || māsaddhamāsā paññāyanti utusaṃvaccharā paññāyanti || || 4.
sn56.38:2.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhāve yāva kīvañca Tathāgato nuppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho || neva tāva mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti mahato obhāsassa ||
sn56.38:2.6: neva tāva catunnam ariyasaccānam ācikkhanā hoti desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānikammaṃ || || 5.
sn56.38:3.1: Yato ca bhikkhave Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho || atha mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti mahato obhāsassa ||
sn56.38:3.2: na andhantamaṃ tadā hoti na andhakāratimisā ||
sn56.38:3.3: atha kho catunnam ariyasaccānam ācikkhaṇā hoti || desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaranā vibhajanā uttānikammaṃ || ||
sn56.38:3.5: Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || la || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa || || 7.
sn56.38:4.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
